newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Republic Engineered cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Republic Engineered cut.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers said it cut its rating on Republic Engineered Steels Inc to hold from strong buy.
-- Said "the improved share performance has built into it expectations of a number of fundamental improvements in the company's fortunes and the environment, which we believe are overstated."
-- Cut the December quarter earnings estimate to loss of $0.45 a share from loss of $0.23 a share. Cut full year 1997 estimates to loss of $1.72 a share from loss of $0.84 a share.
